collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Saloon 2016 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz E Class Saloon 2016 - 2022 (W213) model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
